verdict.rationale: Snyk supports natural-language operation via its MCP server/Snyk Studio (prompting a coding agent with phrases like "scan my directory for security issues") and slash commands like /snyk-fix and /snyk-batch-fix within coding assistants, plus the Remediation Agent that scans, plans, applies, and verifies fixes autonomously. However, core Snyk usage still relies heavily on structured CLI commands (snyk test, snyk code test) and dashboards rather than natural language, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence validating the natural-language MCP workflow in practice. missing for 10: independent verification of natural-language MCP/agent workflows working reliably, broader natural-language coverage beyond fix/scan commands, and evidence of NL support across all Snyk products (Container, IaC) rather than just Code/Remediation.
